lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, with a higher concentration of smaller spots in the anterior dorsal-lateral region transitioning to larger, more widely spaced spots along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a distinct rectilinear grid pattern between the primary ridge and the ventral transition.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature runs across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance boundary with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin surface exhibits approximately 10-14 high-luminance spots distributed across the lower and middle portions of the fin's silhouette, with the apex and trailing edge showing lower spot density.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated, low-luminance biotic attachments (remoras) localized on the posterior margin of the right pectoral fin and the ventral thoracic region.
